visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young female toddler with short dark hair, wearing a light grey sweatshirt and grey leggings, stands on a green and white plastic step stool in front of a modern bathroom sink. The room is brightly lit with a large illuminated mirror. (2) The toddler faces the mirror, her reflection showing her curious expression. A woman's hand, wearing a beige sleeve, enters the frame to assist with a blue toothbrush. The background features warm-toned wooden cabinets and a clean white countertop. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the toddler's face as she diligently brushes her teeth with a blue toothbrush that has a white safety guard. Her eyes are wide and focused on the mirror. (4) The camera captures water flowing from a chrome faucet into the white porcelain basin. The toddler extends her arm to rinse her toothbrush under the stream, showing her coordination. (5) The scene transitions to the next day where the toddler is wearing a cream-colored top with a Peter Pan collar. She continues brushing her teeth with the same enthusiasm, looking directly at the camera with a playful smile. (6) In the final phase, the toddler stands back on her stool and waves her hand at the camera while saying goodbye. The reflection in the mirror shows her tiny figure against the bathroom interior as the shot pulls back slightly.
